svg.title: Thirty Days to a Documented Brokerage Pipeline
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-equipment-brokerage-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to a Documented Brokerage Pipeline; subtitle: Four weekly milestones build readiness; the first deal can take two to nine months.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. Activity counts are sprint targets, not observed outcomes. A first-month settlement is not assumed, and the annual Base funnel is not compressed into this 30-day schedule.; caption: Finish the sprint with a narrow equipment thesis, auditable asset records, qualified buyer conversations, and a rehearsed settlement process. Preserve cash for the canonical two-to-nine-month first-deal window instead of funding the business from an assumed first-month commission.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Select one niche and establish operating and evidence requirements; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose a specific equipment class and geography. Complete a licensing activity matrix, seller mandate template, inspection checklist, and $60,000 cash plan. Assign the four Base seats and create Airtable fields for serial number, owner, condition, liens, and price.; label: Days 8-14; value: Build twenty screened records and pursue five documented mandates; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Target 20 distinct seller opportunities and five signed mandates with verified authority and evidence access. Establish independent inspection coverage and a lien-search workflow. Keep unsigned opportunities separate from inventory authorized for advertising.; label: Days 15-21; value: Qualify ten buyer conversations and test three asset matches; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Target ten conversations with identified purchasing decision-makers and three asset-specific matches. Record capacity, budget, location, and purchase timing. Test HubSpot buyer alerts against relevant inventory and retain explicit reasons for rejected matches.; label: Days 22-30; value: Rehearse settlement and publish a cash-aware pipeline review; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Walk one candidate transaction through inspection acceptance, creditor payoff, release documents, escrow instructions, and commission reconciliation. Use a simulation if no transaction is ready. Review cohort counts, blocked evidence, cash runway, and the next month's seller and buyer follow-up commitments.

text.title: Thirty Days to a Documented Brokerage Pipeline
text.tspan: Thirty Days to a Documented Brokerage Pipeline

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Select one niche and establish operating and evidence requirements; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose a specific equipment class and geography. Complete a licensing activity matrix, seller mandate template, inspection checklist, and $60,000 cash plan. Assign the four Base seats and create Airtable fields for serial number, owner, condition, liens, and price.

text.title: Select one niche and establish operating and evidence requirements

circle.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Build twenty screened records and pursue five documented mandates; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Target 20 distinct seller opportunities and five signed mandates with verified authority and evidence access. Establish independent inspection coverage and a lien-search workflow. Keep unsigned opportunities separate from inventory authorized for advertising.

text.title: Build twenty screened records and pursue five documented mandates

circle.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Qualify ten buyer conversations and test three asset matches; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Target ten conversations with identified purchasing decision-makers and three asset-specific matches. Record capacity, budget, location, and purchase timing. Test HubSpot buyer alerts against relevant inventory and retain explicit reasons for rejected matches.

text.title: Qualify ten buyer conversations and test three asset matches

circle.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Rehearse settlement and publish a cash-aware pipeline review; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Walk one candidate transaction through inspection acceptance, creditor payoff, release documents, escrow instructions, and commission reconciliation. Use a simulation if no transaction is ready. Review cohort counts, blocked evidence, cash runway, and the next month's seller and buyer follow-up commitments.

text.title: Rehearse settlement and publish a cash-aware pipeline review

Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone end days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. Activity counts are sprint targets, not observed outcomes. A first-month settlement is not assumed, and the annual Base funnel is not compressed into this 30-day schedule.
